changelog: Right-click visualizer entry on every OS (Review & merge in visualizer...): reorder, remove, change page size/orientation/rotation before merging.
Selection order is the merge contract: CLI --sort selection default for file selections, GUI forces selection sort on preload and manual reorder, web merges strictly in list order.
Desktop GUI gains Top/Bottom reorder, Rotate control and numbered rows; web visualizer gains orientation, sort-by-name, move-to-top/bottom and image thumbnails.
Universal one-line installer install.py (Python, stdlib only) alongside the native install.ps1 / install.sh one-liners.
New end-to-end tests for order, reorder, page size and the visualizer verbs (test_visualizer_order.py, test_install_py.py).
